AI CLI 工具社区动态日报 2026-09-09

生成时间: 2026-09-09 09:31 UTC | 覆盖工具: 9 个

  • Claude Code
  • OpenAI Codex
  • Gemini CLI
  • GitHub Copilot CLI
  • Kimi Code CLI
  • OpenCode
  • Pi
  • Qwen Code
  • DeepSeek TUI
  • Claude Code Skills

横向对比

AI CLI 工具横向对比分析报告（2026-09-09）

1. 生态全景

当前 AI CLI 工具已全面进入 Agent 能力竞赛 + 稳定性补课 的双轨阶段。主流工具均以平均每日 1-4 次版本迭代的频率快速演进（OpenAI Codex 单日发布 4 个 alpha、Gemini 单日 3 个版本），功能上从"代码补全/聊天"加速向"自主执行、多 Agent 协作、持久记忆、桌面/Web 多形态"演进。与此同时，Windows 平台兼容性、长会话恢复可靠性、MCP 生态的协议级联问题成为全行业通病——多个工具社区的热门 Issue 高度同质化，反映用户对"能跑通"的基本诉求仍未完全满足。模型接入层面，各工具正从"支持某家 API"转向"精细适配"（reasoning effort、会话 ID、tool call 兼容性），生态互操作开始产生连锁效应。

2. 各工具活跃度对比

注：Issue/PR 数为各摘要中主动跟踪/提及的数量，非仓库当日全量。Claude Code 与 DeepSeek TUI 因摘要生成失败，暂无数据。

工具 热点 Issues 关键 PR（开放/合并） Release 数 今日信号
OpenAI Codex 10（最高 51 评论） ~20 个合并（bot 提交为主） 4 个 alpha（rust-v0.154.0 系列） 0.154.0 快速迭代，Windows/WSL 问题集中爆发
Gemini CLI 10（最高 13 评论） 10（5 开放 / 5 关闭，多为合并） 3（nightly / preview / stable） Agent 中断误报、Shell 卡死等稳定性质疑
GitHub Copilot CLI 10（最高 11 评论） 2 个实质 PR，1 个无效 PR 2 个修复版（v1.0.84-2/3） Vim 模式正式开放；Windows 会话管理成为众矢之的
Kimi Code CLI 3 2（1 合并 / 1 开放） 0 登录 HTTP 500 阻断所有用户，属高危信号
OpenCode 10（最高 36 评论） 10（多为开放中） 1（v1.18.30） 数据库膨胀 13GB+ 与 prompt 缓存缺失成最大槽点
Pi (pi-mono) 10（最高 10 评论） 1（文档向） 0 OpenCode Go 新协议头导致多 provider 兼容性连锁故障
Qwen Code 10（最高 33 评论） 10（含大功能 PR） 4（stable + preview + 2 SDK） TUI 渲染层迁移与 daemon 架构演进并行
Claude Code — — — 数据缺失
DeepSeek TUI — — — 数据缺失

活跃度梯度：Gemini ≈ OpenCode ≈ Qwen ≈ Codex（高频迭代 + 高讨论量） > Copilot（稳定但问题集中） > Pi（中低活跃、集成属性强） > Kimi（体量小、问题单一且紧急）。

3. 共同关注的功能方向

3.1 长会话 / 上下文可靠性（全行业第一痛点）

  • OpenCode：event 表无限膨胀至 13GB+（#33356）；Agent 累积 51 张图片导致会话卡死（#47487）
  • Copilot：恢复会话时 JS 堆 OOM（#4664）；stale item ID 导致所有 prompt 报 400（#4505）；FileWatch 死循环生成 13GB 日志（#4612）
  • Gemini：Subagent 中断后误报 GOAL 成功（#22323）；上下文被中断回合污染（PR #29265）
  • Codex：分页线程历史在 token_count 处停止投影（#40342）
  • Pi：Esc 取消流式请求经常失效（#8823）

3.2 Windows 平台支持短板

  • Codex：#41290（WSL 项目创建失败）、#25178（Computer Use 截图失败）、#29639（WSL 路径映射错误）
  • Copilot：#4756 / #4742（Windows 无法创建第二个 Local 会话）、#3858（快捷键失效）
  • Qwen：#11303（conhost.exe 泄漏 347 个子进程，占 2.8GB 内存）
  • Gemini：Browser 子代理在 Wayland 环境失败（#21983，同为显示服务器类问题）

3.3 MCP 生态的"可靠、安全、可管理"

  • Copilot：MCP 握手超时从 16s 缩短到 1s 导致静默不可用（#4753）、OAuth scope 参数缺失
  • Gemini：MCP OAuth 强制执行 RFC 9207 issuer 标识（PR #29121）
  • Pi：WebSocket 重试仅识别两种错误码，其他瞬时故障直接终止回合（#7444）
  • OpenCode：OpenRouter 路由修饰符无法解析（PR #48117）

3.4 模型/Provider 适配的精细度

  • Copilot：OpenRouter 集成诉求（#2943）
  • Pi：OpenCode Go 新硬性要求 x-opencode-session 头导致多个 provider 请求失败（#9230/#9302/#9326）
  • OpenCode：Bedrock 缓存输入重复计数触发自动压缩（#47296）；Zen 模型下拉框缺失（#43805）
  • Qwen：本地 llama-server sampler 初始化失败（#10530）；GPT-5/6 reasoning effort 配置（PR #11295）

3.5 编辑器 / 终端 UX 体验补全

  • Copilot：Vim 模式落地（#13）；Ctrl+Backspace 删除单词（#2199）
  • Qwen：TUI 渲染层从 ink 迁移到 OpenTUI（#8662）
  • OpenCode：会话时间线查找栏（PR #48088）
  • Kimi：VS Code 中 @ 优先显示已打开文件（#1270，已关闭）
  • Pi：全屏模式滚动性能慢 3 倍（#9052）
  • Gemini：符号链接的 agent 文件不被识别（#20079）

4. 差异化定位分析

工具 核心定位 技术路线 目标用户 独特卖点 当前短板
OpenAI Codex OpenAI 生态的官方 Agent 入口 Rust 核心 + 桌面应用 + Computer Use（GUI 自动化） OpenAI 重度用户 / Pro 订阅者 Computer Use 视觉操作、与 ChatGPT 生态深度绑定 Windows/WSL 支持明显滞后；alpha 频繁但变更日志缺失
Gemini CLI Google 系全能 Agent 平台 Node/TS + 子代理（subagent）+ Browser Agent + Auto Memory Google 生态开发者、多 Agent 工作流用户 内置浏览器代理、自动记忆、技能系统 Agent 稳定性问题集中（挂起、误报、卡死）；AST 感知仍在评估
GitHub Copilot CLI GitHub 工作流原生的轻量 CLI Node.js + 桌面应用 + MCP 扩展 GitHub 重度用户、IDE 开发者 Vim 模式、GitHub 一站式体验、企业级身份体系 长会话稳定性"欠债"严重；Windows 体验滞后
Kimi Code 轻量级中文友好的 CLI 伴侣 Node/TS + VS Code 扩展 中文开发者、Moonshot 模型用户 体积小、上手快、与 Kimi Web/App 联动 官方维护资源有限；登录链路存在高危未修复问题
OpenCode 模型无关的开源 Agent 运行时 TypeScript + 多 Provider SDK（OpenAI/Azure/Bedrock/Ollama…）+ TUI/Desktop 追求开放性与自定义的开发者 Provider 中立、2.0 架构可扩展、桌面端持续重构 存储膨胀与缓存策略是系统性隐患；数据治理能力不足
Pi (pi-mono) 连接多 Agent 生态的"路由器" 多 Provider 适配层 + TUI（基于 OpenCode 生态） 使用 Pi 统一管理多种模型后端的开发者 轻量、统一入口、快速适配新模型/协议 依赖上游协议变更，易受 OpenCode/Codex 新要求冲击
Qwen Code 企业级全栈 Agent 工作台 daemon 架构 + Web Shell（IDE 化）+ Mesh 多 Agent 协作 + 本地模型支持 企业团队、需要私有化/本地模型的中大型用户 支持本地 llama-server、Web Shell 功能密度高、持久化共享线程协作 WebUI 退役带来 breaking change；local 模型兼容性波动
Claude Code Anthropic 官方 CLI Agent 数据缺失 Claude 用户 数据缺失 数据缺失

5. 社区热度与成熟度

  • 最活跃（快速迭代期）：OpenAI Codex（单日 4 个 alpha + 20 PR 合并）、Gemini（nightly/preview/stable 三线并进，PR 与 Issue 同步高活跃）、OpenCode（功能与 Bug 修复并重，桌面端重构规模大）、Qwen（daemon 架构 + Web Shell + Mesh 协作三线推进，功能密度极高）。这四家正处于功能扩展快于稳定性沉淀的阶段，Issue 数量与 PR 数量同步走高。

  • 稳定迭代期：GitHub Copilot CLI 版本节奏保守（两个修复版），Vim 模式等长线需求逐步落地，但社区对会话稳定性的信任危机正在积累（OOM、stale ID、FileWatch 失控等"开盲盒"式问题），属于稳中有忧。

  • 低活跃 / 依赖型：Pi 无独立版本发布，其活跃度本质是"OpenCode/Codex 生态变更的涟漪效应"；Kimi 体量最小，但登录 500 这类阻断性问题说明其服务端成熟度与主流工具存在代差。

  • 成熟度判断：论生态完整度，Gemini 与 Qwen 领先（Agent + Memory + 协作 + 多形态前端）；论模型兼容性，OpenCode 覆盖面最广

各工具详细报告

Claude Code — anthropics/claude-code

Claude Code Skills 社区热点

数据来源: anthropics/skills

Claude Code Skills 社区热点报告

数据源: github.com/anthropics/skills | 截止: 2026-09-09

1. 热门 Skills 排行（Top 8 PR）

说明：以下 PR 均处于 Open 状态，按社区评论活跃度排序。

  1. skill-creator 评估脚本修复（#1298）

    • 功能：修复 run_eval.py 恒报 0% 召回率的核心 Bug，涉及 Windows 流读取、触发检测与并行 worker。
    • 热点：对应 Issue #556（12 条评论），10+ 用户独立复现，整个 description 优化循环一直在"用噪声做优化"。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/1298

  2. document-typography（文档排版质量控制）（#514）

    • 功能：治理 AI 生成文档的孤儿词换行、寡行段落、编号错位等普遍排版问题。
    • 热点：直击 Claude 生成文档的"最后一公里"体验，社区讨论集中在 typographic 规则的可枚举性与执行边界。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/514

  3. scnet-hpc（HPC 集群运维）（#1615）

    • 功能：通过 profile 化 SSH + Slurm 工作流操作 SCNet HPC 集群，覆盖分区、内存、模块、加速器等。
    • 热点：反映科研/超算场景用户对垂直领域 Skill 的需求。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/1615

  4. pdf Skill 大小写引用修复（#538）

    • 功能：修复 SKILL.md 中 8 处大小写不匹配的文件引用（REFERENCE.md → reference.md）。
    • 热点：低风险高确定性修复，在大小写敏感文件系统（Linux/macOS）上直接决定 Skill 可用性。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/538

  5. ODT（OpenDocument）文档技能（#486）

    • 功能：创建、填充、读取、转换 .odt/.ods 等 OpenDocument 格式，覆盖 LibreOffice/ISO 标准场景。
    • 热点：补全文档技能矩阵中除 docx/pdf 之外的开源格式空白。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/486

  6. frontend-design Skill 可操作性改进（#210）

    • 功能：重写前端设计技能，确保每条指令可在单次对话内被执行，提升行为引导的精确度。
    • 热点：社区对"描述含糊的 Skill 无效"的典型回应——回归可执行性。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/210

  7. skill-quality-analyzer + skill-security-analyzer 元技能（#83）

    • 功能：新增两个元技能，从结构/文档、安全、依赖等维度对 Claude Skills 做质量与安全审计。
    • 热点：与 Issue #492 的安全信任讨论形成共振，是"治理 Skills 的 Skill"方向代表。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/83

  8. docx 修订模式 w:id 冲突修复（#541）

    • 功能：修复 DOCX 技能添加修订时硬编码低 ID 与已有书签/批注 ID 冲突导致的文档损坏。
    • 热点：OOXML 共享 ID 空间问题，根因分析清晰，属高价值稳定性修复。
    • 链接：https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pull/541

2. 社区需求趋势（来自 Issues）

方向 代表 Issue 热度信号
安全与信任边界 #492：社区 Skill 借 anthropic/ 命名空间分发，构成信任边界滥用 43 评论，🔥最热
组织级共享与协作 #228：希望在 Claude.ai 内直接共享 Skill，替代手动传文件 16 评论，8 👍
Skill 工具链可靠性 #556：run_eval.py 全部查询 0% 触发率；#202：skill-creator 冗长低效 12 + 8 评论
质量/治理型元技能 #412：agent-governance；#1385：推理质量门控管线；#1329：compact-memory 紧凑记忆 6 + 4 + 9 评论
上下文窗口效率 #1487：claude-api 单次注入约 156k tokens，直接耗尽上下文 4 评论，严重度高
去重与安装体验 #189：document-skills 与 example-skills 安装重复技能 6 评论，9 👍
平台扩展 #29：AWS Bedrock 支持；#16：将 Skills 暴露为 MCP 各 4 评论

趋势总结：需求正从"新增功能型 Skill"转向"治理型元技能 + 工具链可靠性 + 组织级协作"三层——社区最关心 Skill 本身是否安全、可评估、可共享，而非单纯堆数量。

3. 高潜力待合并 Skills（近期可能落地）

PR 内容 落地概率判断

⚠️ 摘要生成失败。

OpenAI Codex — openai/codex

OpenAI Codex 社区动态日报 — 2026-09-09

1. 今日速览

过去 24 小时内，Codex 发布了 4 个 rust-v0.154.0 系列 alpha 版本，同时约 20 个 PR 被合并（主要由 copyberry[bot] 提交），集中在凭证代理（Credential Broker）重构和 Python SDK 发布流程加固。社区层面，Windows/WSL 环境下的项目创建失败（#41290）和 Computer Use 截图功能异常（#25178）成为热议焦点，凸显 Windows 平台稳定性仍是用户最关心的痛点。

2. 版本发布

过去 24 小时发布了 4 个 Rust 版 alpha 迭代：

  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.11 — Release 0.154.0-alpha.11
  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.10.2 — Release 0.154.0-alpha.10.2
  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.8 — Release 0.154.0-alpha.8
  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.7 — Release 0.154.0-alpha.7

从版本号密集程度来看，项目正为 0.154.0 稳定版进行快速迭代，但官方暂未提供详细变更日志。结合合并的 PR 推测，主要涉及凭证代理、Python SDK 发布流程、语音运行时打包修复等内容。

3. 社区热点 Issues

以下为过去 24 小时内评论数最高的 10 条 Issue，集中反映了当前用户的核心痛点：

#41290 [Windows] 切换 Agent Environment 到 WSL 后项目创建和删除失败

  • 评论 51 | 👍 37
  • ChatGPT Pro 用户反馈，在 Windows 上将 Agent 环境切换至 WSL 后，项目创建/删除功能完全不可用。这是当前社区热度最高的问题。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/41290

#25178 [Windows 10] Computer Use 截图功能在 SetIsBorderRequired 调用时失败

  • 评论 50 | 👍 23
  • Windows 10 22H2 上，Computer Use 可以列出窗口、激活窗口、读取辅助功能文本，但任何调用 get_window_state 请求截图的操作都会以 0x80004002 失败。该问题已持续数月，影响大量 Windows 用户。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/25178

#21700 [Computer Use] Chrome 扩展在 Chrome Web Store 不可用，是否有离线安装包？

  • 评论 29 | 👍 25
  • Codex Desktop 的 Chrome 集成扩展无法从 Chrome 网上应用店下载，页面显示错误。用户急需离线安装包或替代分发渠道。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/21700

#40342 [Bug] 分页线程历史投影在遇到 token_count 记录时停止

  • 评论 24 | 👍 8
  • 长聊天的线程历史在分页加载时，遇到 token_count 记录会停止投影，导致后续消息无法显示。影响多版本（0.145.0 和 0.149.0）桌面端用户。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/40342

#29639 [Windows] WSL 工作区中 Browser Use Node REPL 因 sandboxCwd 未映射而失败

  • 评论 22 | 👍 7
  • Windows 桌面应用在 WSL 文件系统上运行 agent 时，自动生成的 node_repl MCP server 仍使用 Windows 路径，导致工具调用传入 Linux 路径而失败。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/29639

#42501 [Windows] 26.901.1978.0 更新后应用无法启动 UI

  • 评论 13 | 👍 1
  • 升级到 26.901.1978.0 后，Codex 启动了多个 ChatGPT.exe 进程但始终没有可见窗口。调查指向新打包的 cua_node 运行时无法复制 node_repl.exe。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/42501

#30910 [Feature] 重新开启 #19464，支持 1M 上下文

  • 评论 11 | 👍 8
  • 用户呼吁将上下文窗口从 272k 提升至 1M。他们认为 GPT-5.5 时代 272k 已成为实际瓶颈，且相关讨论常被官方关闭。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/30910

#43058 [Bug] Prompt 被误报违反 usage policy

  • 评论 11 | 👍 0
  • Codex CLI v0.153.4 搭配 gpt-6-astra 时，正常 prompt 被错误标记为违反使用政策，导致任务无法执行。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/43058

#30271 [Bug] 合法逆向工程工作被误报“网络霸凌”政策违规

  • 评论 8 | 👍 4
  • 已通过 OpenAI 网络安全验证（chatgpt.com/cyber）的用户，在进行自有硬件的逆向工程和漏洞分析时，仍被安全策略拦截。
  • https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/30271

#41480 [macOS] “Open in” 子菜单永远显示 “Loading available apps…”

社区最关心的三个方向：

  1. Agent 执行可靠性：中断误报、挂起、命令卡死等稳定性问题集中在 P1/P2 级，且复现率高。
  2. AST 感知与上下文效率：多个 EPIC 投入评估通过 AST 工具降低 token 消耗、提升代码导航精度。
  3. Auto Memory 安全与质量：批量出现的相关 Issue 表明自动记忆功能正经历安全审查与质量加固。

开发者关注点

  • 中断后的信号误导：子代理在中断后仍上报 GOAL 成功，开发者认为 Agent 的终止原因系统需要重新设计，至少应区分 INTERRUPTED 与 GOAL。（#22323）
  • 交互式提示挂起：创建 Vite 应用等交互式命令会让 CLI 卡死在提示符处，且 /compress 在会话恢复后不生效。（#22465, #21335）
  • 配置与路径兼容：settings.json 覆盖被 Browser Agent 忽略（#22267）、符号链接的 agent 文件不被识别（#20079）、BOM 编码内容误判（#29155）——权限与文件系统的边界case仍需打磨。
  • 上下文污染问题：中断回合会导致后续 prompt 失效（PR #29265），开发者对当前中断机制的健壮性存疑，期待后续版本修复。
  • 工具过多时的 400 错误：超过 400 个工具时 CLI 报 400 错误，开发者希望 Agent 能按需裁剪工具集合，而非一次性全部加载。（#24246）

  • 自动批准模式抗衰减：#4764 中"1 小时失效"虽然仅 1 条评论，但其对流水线式工作流的破坏力极大，应纳入高优 triage 队列。

  • 链接: MoonshotAI/kimi-cli PR #2595
  • 时间: 创建 2026-08-06 | 更新 2026-09-08
  • 关联: 解决 Issue #2591
  • 内容: 当前 StrReplaceFile 使用 errors="replace" 解码整个文件，编辑后回写时任何非 UTF-8 字节都会被替换为 U+FFFD（即便与编辑位置无关），导致文件损坏。该 PR 改为直接拒绝编辑非 UTF-8 文件。

  5. 支持托管自定义 Web Shell 分发版 — #11358（4 评论，P3） qwen serve 目前只能使用内置 Web Shell，集成方希望托管自己的前端应用且保留 daemon API，能独立更新前端而无需重建 Agent。

  6. daemon 的 Skill 管理状态与 ACP child 解耦 — #11274（4 评论，P3） 规划通过一系列 1000 行以内的 PR 分阶段实现，daemon 负责目录和持久化，child 负责执行 Skill 并上报结果。社区关注 daemon 架构的演进方向。

  7. review: filter screen 丢失六项安全加固 — #11205（4 评论，P2） main 分支的 filter screen 在合并时丢失了读顺序、EACCES、U+FFFD、spawn 超时、候选上限、保留策略等六项加固，安全相关，值得跟踪。

  8. bug(lsp): 磁盘编辑后查询返回陈旧文档内容 — #11439（3 评论，P2） 文件在磁盘上修改后，LSP 查询仍返回旧内容（如 hover 仍显示 number 而非 string），影响依赖 LSP 的编辑体验。

  9. provider 配置 reasoning 的边界情况跟进 — #11328（3 评论，P2） PR #10999 限制了首期范围，此 issue 记录后续边界情况，包括 deepseek-v4-pro 等模型的 reasoning 配置补全。

  10. ask_user_question 待处理卡片在会话重开后丢失 — #11448（2 评论，P2） 模型调用 ask_user_question 后，卡片在会话重开时消失但侧边栏仍显示 "Input needed"，属于 daemon + Web Shell 的话路状态一致性问题。

重要 PR 进展（10 个）

  1. feat(mesh): 增加持久化的共享线程 Agent 协作 — #11206 为工作区引入持久化的 Agent 身份，支持共享线程上的人员与 Agent 协同工作：创建/分配任务、多 Agent 寻址、进程干预、结果审查、取消、阻塞解决和已审阅线程标记。大型功能，daemon 方向核心 PR。

  2. feat(core): 为 deferred tools 保留 prompt cache — #10410 以 tool_search + tool_call 两步桥接替代直接 schema 暴露，模型可审查 deferred tool schema 而不改变声明工具列表，同时在现有执行管线中校验和调用。对长会话 token 成本优化意义重大。

  3. fix(cli): 恢复 OpenTUI banner、footer 和 loading 状态 — #11437（已合并） 修复 OpenTUI 下缺失的终端 UI 元素，同时包含 OSS 镜像发版修复。与 #8662 迁移方向一致。

  4. feat(sessions): 记录会话注册类型并完善注册契约与文档 — #11463 会话注册记录新增 kind 字段（tui/headless/serve/external），为后续无头模式和外部注册方铺路。

  5. feat(web-shell): 从工作区分支选择器管理 git remote — #11163 在 Web Shell 的 git popover 中新增 Manage Remotes 面板，支持列出、添加、删除 remote（删除需二次确认），补全 Web 端 Git 操作能力。

  6. feat(web-shell): 已答问题在 Processed 摘要之外保持可见 — #11461 AskUserQuestion 完成后的结果以结构化气泡保留（问题在上、答案在下），支持多行文本和字面代码，且不计入 Processed 的工具计数。

  7. feat: 支持 GPT-5 和 GPT-6 reasoning effort 配置 — #11295（已合并） 为已知 GPT-5 和 GPT-6 Astra 模型添加 reasoning effort 配置，统一处理 provider 前缀、路由标签、空白字符和快照版本等归一化逻辑。

  8. fix(dws): 强制禁用聊天源 — #11355 让 DingTalk Workspace 的群聊和单聊访问策略成为真正的源级开关：不订阅、不轮询历史、不通过迟到事件回调放行、不从持久化挂起工作中重放。

  9. feat(core): 扩展 Kimi、Qwen 和 DeepSeek reasoning 预设 — #11349 为 Moonshot K3（low/high/max）、K2.7 Code（thinking-only）、K2.6（原生 thinking 开关）、Qwen 3.8（low/medium/xhigh）、DeepSeek V4 Pro 等模型补齐 reasoning 预设。

  10. feat(web-shell): 增加 Web 预览面板及保存投递历史 — #11276 支持对浏览器可达的开发 URL 提供桌面/移动宽度预览、刷新和外部打开。Standalone Web Shell 默认启用，embedded host 可 opt-in。

功能需求趋势

  • Web Shell 成为功能主战场：品牌定制（#11357）、URL 可点击、Git remote 管理、Web 预览面板、已答问题可见性等密集交付，Web Shell 正在从基础终端逐步演进为完整 IDE 形态。
  • daemon 架构解耦与文档化：Skill 管理从 child 解耦（#11274）、REST/SSE API 文档整合（#11359）、自定义 Web Shell 托管（#11358）、外部持久化讨论（#11440），说明第三方集成需求正在快速增长。
  • 新模型与新能力接入：GPT-5/6 reasoning（#11295）、Kimi/DeepSeek presets（[#11349](https://github.com/QwenLM
DeepSeek TUI — Hmbown/DeepSeek-TUI

item.content:encoded:
AI CLI Tools Community Digest 2026-09-09

Generated: 2026-09-09 09:31 UTC | Tools covered: 9

  • Claude Code
  • OpenAI Codex
  • Gemini CLI
  • GitHub Copilot CLI
  • Kimi Code CLI
  • OpenCode
  • Pi
  • Qwen Code
  • DeepSeek TUI
  • Claude Code Skills

Cross-Tool Comparison

Cross-Tool Comparison Report — AI CLI Developer Tools

Coverage window: 2026-09-09 community digests for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kimi Code CLI. Digests for OpenCode, Pi, Qwen Code, and DeepSeek TUI were unavailable (summary generation failed) and are excluded from quantitative comparisons.

1. Ecosystem Overview

The AI CLI tool landscape is in a phase of rapid, security-focused iteration. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google all shipped releases within 24 hours, with OpenAI's Codex alone publishing four alpha builds. Community attention is concentrated on infrastructure reliability — sandboxing, credential handling, session continuity, and Windows/WSL parity — rather than raw model capability. A significant cross-tool pattern is emerging: as agents gain autonomy (subagents, background skills, Computer Use), users are demanding honest status reporting, interruption-safe state, and transparent security boundaries. Extension and plugin models (Claude Code's Function Hooks proposal at 150 comments; Gemini's skills system) are becoming the key differentiator battleground.

2. Activity Comparison

Counts reflect highlighted items in each digest (hot issues / key PRs), not full GitHub totals. All figures are for the 2026-09-09 window.

Tool Issues Highlighted PRs Highlighted Releases Release Notes
Claude Code 10 1 2 v2.1.266 (gateway hotfix), v2.1.265 (telemetry, --plugin-dir)
OpenAI Codex 10 10 4 rust-v0.154.0-alpha.7 / alpha.8 / alpha.10.2 / alpha.11
Gemini CLI 10 10 3 v0.61.0-nightly, v0.60.0-preview.0, v0.59.0 stable
GitHub Copilot CLI 3 (section truncated) 0 listed 2 v1.0.84-3, v1.0.84-2 (Vim mode GA)
Kimi Code CLI 3 2 0 —
OpenCode / Pi / Qwen Code / DeepSeek TUI n/a n/a n/a Digest generation failed

3. Shared Feature Directions

Several requirements recur across tool communities, independently:

  • Subagent reliability & honest status reporting. Gemini CLI users report MAX_TURNS and Wayland failures being misreported as "GOAL success" (#22323, #21983); generalist agent hangs force workarounds (#21409). Claude Code shows adjacent symptoms: --resume renders stale messages after compaction (#46603). Across tools, users want visible subagent trajectories and truthful termination reasons — not silent masking.
  • Windows/WSL parity. Codex has four of ten hot issues rooted in WSL path-mapping and sandbox failures (#41290, #29639, #42501, #25178); Copilot CLI's truncated issue list begins with a Windows desktop regression (#4756); Gemini's latest nightly includes NTFS short-name mitigation (#29116). Cross-platform execution remains the largest single source of friction.
  • Sandboxing without collateral damage. Gemini PR #29156 reverts an over-aggressive sandbox

Per-Tool Reports

Claude Code — anthropics/claude-code

Claude Code Skills Highlights

Source: anthropics/skills

⚠️ Skills summary generation failed.

Claude Code Community Digest — 2026-09-09

Today's Highlights

Anthropic shipped two quick releases to address a gateway/proxy regression: v2.1.265 introduced telemetry fields and folder-based --plugin-dir support, while v2.1.266 fixed a 2.1.265 regression where the CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY env var forced Cloud sign-in prematurely. On the community side, the Function Hooks proposal (#91870) is the dominant discussion (150 comments), and the long-running copy/paste whitespace bug (#18170) crossed 292 👍, making it the most-voted open issue. Several data-loss and correctness bugs in Desktop session transcripts and --resume also gained attention.

Releases

v2.1.266 — Hotfix for a 2.1.265 regression: the undocumented CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY env var, previously only honored when both ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN were set, began forcing Cloud-gateway sign-in on its own. LLM-gateway and proxy setups should restore their previous behavior. Release v2.1.266

v2.1.265 — Two changes: (1) user.email and user.groups are now included in telemetry forwarded through a Claude apps gateway, matching terminal sessions; (2) --plugin-dir can now point at a folder of plugins — every child folder with a manifest loads, and children added/removed are picked up dynamically. Release v2.1.265

Hot Issues

  1. #91870 — Function Hooks: make plugins 10x more powerful — 150 comments, 88 👍 · The week's highest-engagement discussion proposes a deep plugin extension model with a parameterized $ object, side-effect tracking, and an Express/Koa-style next() continuation model. If adopted, this could substantially reshape the plugin ecosystem.

  2. #18170 — Copy/paste from terminal includes unwanted indentation/trailing spaces — 135 comments, 292 👍 · The most-upvoted open issue. Copied code retains prompt-alignment indentation and trailing whitespace, corrupting pasted snippets. A daily annoyance for heavy TUI users that has now drawn sustained community pressure.

  3. #65961 — Claude writes verbose code comments by default, ignoring instructions to stop — 31 comments, 205 👍 · A model-behavior complaint: explicit prompts to avoid comments are repeatedly ignored. High 👍 count signals broad frustration with comment verbosity.

  4. #83033 — Sonnet 5 corrupts Hangul in tool-call parameters via mis-spelled \uXXXX escapes — 6 comments, 134 👍 · A root-caused, 100%-repro bug where Korean text in tool parameters is written as Unicode escapes with corrupted hex, breaking AskUserQuestion/TodoWrite. Likely the cause behind earlier Korean-corruption reports.

  5. #86928 — Sandboxed Bash intermittently fails: unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER): Invalid argument — 14 comments, 8 👍 · With sandbox: { enabled: true } on Linux, roughly 1 in 10 Bash calls fails in seccomp setup. Reproduced; impacts anyone relying on sandboxing for safety.

  6. #76694 — Cowork macOS: "Choose a folder" lost after Chat/Cowork merge — 16 comments, 20 👍 · A UX regression where new projects can no longer pick a folder — the context menu was replaced by a chat-style upload-only knowledge menu.

  7. #29415 — GitHub connector missing from /mcp despite being connected in settings — 12 comments, 14 👍 · GitHub silently fails to appear in the MCP list while all 19 other connectors sync. Likely a connector-sync bug specific to GitHub.

  8. #92825 — Desktop session transcripts silently become permanently unavailable — 7 comments · A follow-up to #79044: cliSessionId is nulled and transcripts are lost with no local recovery path. Data-loss severity; notable because it's a recurrence.

  9. #46603 — --resume shows stale messages after context compaction — 7 comments · Compaction creates messages with parentUuid references to deleted history, so resumes display days-old conversations and appear to lose recent work.

  10. #93043 — statusLine goes blank under cmux after 2.1.263 — new today, 0 comments · A freshly filed regression: the status line renders nothing in new sessions under cmux after the 2.1.263 auto-update, with no errors. Likely a rendering-path regression worth watching.

Key PR Progress

Only one PR was updated in the 24-hour window, so this section is limited.

#63686 — Bump stale and autoclose timeouts from 14 to 90 days — closed · A long-dormant lifecycle PR (opened May, closed Sept 8) that would extend both the "stale

OpenAI Codex — openai/codex

OpenAI Codex Community Digest — 2026-09-09

Today's Highlights

Release activity continues with four new rust-v0.154.0 alpha builds, while pull request momentum is concentrated on credential brokering, Python SDK publishing, and release/packaging hardening. On the issue side, Windows/WSL workspace and Computer Use failures dominate community discussion, with several high-traffic threads crossing 50 comments.

Releases

Four Rust pre-release builds shipped in the last 24 hours:

  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.7
  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.8
  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.10.2
  • rust-v0.154.0-alpha.11

No detailed changelogs were attached; these appear to be iterative fixes leading toward a stable 0.154.0.

Hot Issues

Top issues by community engagement and impact:

  • [Windows][WSL] Project creation and removal fail after switching Agent Environment to WSL — 51 comments, 37 👍
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/41290
    A major workflow blocker for Windows users relying on WSL workspaces.

  • Windows Computer Use screenshot fails on Windows 10 22H2 with SetIsBorderRequired error — 50 comments, 23 👍
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/25178
    Computer Use can list and activate windows but cannot capture screenshots, crippling the core experience.

  • Computer Use Chrome extension unavailable in Chrome Web Store; offline installer needed — 29 comments, 25 👍
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/21700
    Distribution/availability problem blocking browser automation features.

  • Paginated thread history projection stops at a token_count record — 24 comments
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/40342
    Long-session thread history renders incorrectly after pagination.

  • Browser Use Node REPL fails in Windows Desktop with WSL workspace due to unmapped sandboxCwd — 22 comments
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/29639
    Path-mapping mismatch between Windows app and WSL filesystem breaks MCP tooling.

  • Windows app fails to launch UI when cua_node staging cannot copy node_repl.exe — 13 comments
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/42501
    Recent update can leave Codex Desktop stuck without a visible window.

  • Reopen #19464 and support 1M context — 11 comments, 8 👍
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/30910
    Continued demand for larger context windows beyond the current 272k.

  • Invalid prompt: flagged as potentially violating usage policy — 11 comments
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/43058
    Users hit false policy blocks on ordinary prompts, hurting reliability.

  • False “Cyber Abuse” Policy Flag for legitimate reverse engineering work — 8 comments
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/30271
    Safety over-blocking affecting verified security researchers.

  • macOS “Open in” submenu stays on “Loading available apps…” indefinitely — 5 comments, 7 👍
    https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/41480
    Desktop integration regression on macOS.

Key PR Progress

Important merged/closed PRs from the last 24 hours:

  • Support credential brokering in plaintext HTTP tunnels
    Extends credential interception to HTTP CONNECT and SOCKS5 tunnels, not just TLS.

  • Add untrusted external messages to the Python SDK
    Exposes ExternalMessage for sync and async run(...), enabling tool-level content delivery without user-authorization semantics.

  • Expose Python SDK history selection and per-turn options
    Adds response-history control and per-turn service-tier overrides with runtime compatibility checks.

  • Publish Python packages after stable CLI releases
    Adds a downstream workflow to publish and verify Python SDK/runtime on PyPI from stable CLI commits.

  • Raise Guardian's action review limit to 200,000 bytes
    Increases action review capacity from 8 KB to 200 KB, while keeping stdin approvals capped separately.

  • Add configurable credential providers to the network proxy
    Introduces environment-variable-based credential providers with bearer/token/Basic/custom header auth.

  • Fix voice runtime release builds and packaging
    Builds voice runtimes with -c opt, fixes path resolution, and seals release archives correctly.

  • Harden credential handling in shell snapshots and replay
    Decodes shell literals safely and prevents startup files from restoring real credentials after dummy replacement.

  • Use StartThreadOptions across thread fork APIs
    Unifies thread-fork configuration and startup arguments into one options structure.

  • Reject empty audio payloads in data URLs
    Returns a clear AudioPreparationError::InvalidDataUrl instead of proceeding with invalid input.

Feature Request Trends

The most requested feature directions from recent issues:

  • Larger context windows — Continued pressure to raise the 272k context limit, with calls to reopen previous 1M-context requests.
  • Better long-thread navigation — Requests for message bookmarks and minimap improvements to handle long Codex App sessions.
  • Restored desktop “Open with” workflows — macOS users want a one-click top-right menu for opening the current workspace in editors like VS Code and Cursor.
  • Offline and alternative distribution — The missing Chrome Web Store extension has users asking for offline installers.
  • Improved WSL integration — Users want seamless path mapping, sandbox behavior, and project lifecycle management when Codex switches between Windows and WSL environments.

Developer Pain Points

Recurring frustrations across recent issues:

  • Windows + WSL path mismatches are causing sandbox setup failures, MCP tool breakage, and project creation/removal errors.
  • Computer Use reliability is a top concern: screenshot capture, Chrome extension availability, and node_repl.exe staging all fail in different Windows configurations.
  • Desktop regressions after updates — Windows and macOS builds are frequently reported with launch hangs, reconnecting loops, or missing UI elements.
  • Thread/history migration bugs — Paginated threads, subagent histories, and migrated rollouts show empty or truncated projections.
  • False-positive policy flags on legitimate prompts and security work are eroding trust in model-behavior guardrails.
Gemini CLI — google-gemini/gemini-cli

Gemini CLI Community Digest — 2026-09-09

1. Today's Highlights

The project shipped three releases in the last 24 hours, headlined by nightly v0.61.0 with Windows NTFS path mitigation and sandbox container isolation fixes. Meanwhile, a critical PR landed to prevent session context poisoning on interrupted agent turns, addressing a long-standing frustration for developers who frequently Ctrl-C long-running agent tasks. The issue tracker continues to spotlight subagent reliability — misreported MAX_TURNS terminations, generalist agent hangs, and a lack of autonomous skill usage remain the loudest community complaints.

2. Releases

v0.61.0-nightly.20260909.ged2ac40df — Latest nightly

  • fix(core): Mitigate NTFS 8.3 short name (SFN) path issues (#29116)
  • fix(cli): Isolate settings directory inside sandbox containers (#29216)

v0.60.0-preview.0 — Preview release

  • fix(core): Improve destination validation and connection routing in web fetch utilities (#29120)
  • fix(core): Enforce RFC 9207 issuer identification in the MCP OAuth flow

v0.59.0 — Stable release

  • Changelog for v0.58.0-preview.0, version bumps, and ongoing core stability fixes.

3. Hot Issues

  1. #22323 — Subagent recovery after MAX_TURNS is reported as GOAL success · 13 comments · p1 bug The codebase_investigator subagent reports status: "success" with Termination Reason: "GOAL" even when it hit MAX_TURNS before doing any analysis. This silently masks interruptions and has drawn sustained community attention — a top correctness concern for multi-agent workflows.

  2. #19873 — Zero-Dependency OS Sandboxing & Post-Execution Intent Routing · 9 comments · p2 enhancement Proposes letting Gemini 3's native bash affinity run freely inside OS-level sandboxes, then routing command intent post-execution. Backed by the maintainer team, this could meaningfully change the shell-execution security model.

  3. #21409 — Generalist agent hangs · 8 comments · 8 👍 · p1 bug Simple tasks like folder creation hang indefinitely when deferred to the generalist agent — users report waiting up to an hour. The only workaround today is explicitly instructing the model to avoid subagents. High community resonance given the 👍 count.

  4. #22745 — AST-aware file reads, search, and mapping · 7 comments · p2 feature/EPIC Tracks whether AST-aware tools can reduce token noise, improve method-bound reads, and sharpen code navigation. Companion issue #22746 suggests tilth or glyph as starting points.

  5. #21968 — Gemini does not use skills and sub-agents enough · 6 comments · p2 bug Anecdotal but widely echoed: Gemini ignores custom skills and sub-agents unless explicitly instructed. Users with gradle and git skills report the model rarely self-triggers them, undermining the extensibility story.

  6. #26525 — Add deterministic redaction and reduce Auto Memory logging · 5 comments · p2 security bug Auto Memory sends transcript content to an extraction model before prompt-based redaction occurs, and the service can log skill content. A security-relevant concern for teams using the memory system with sensitive codebases.

  7. #26522 — Stop Auto Memory from retrying low-signal sessions indefinitely · 4 comments · p2 bug Sessions the extractor deems low-signal are never marked processed, so they resurface repeatedly. Part of a broader cluster of Auto Memory quality issues (#26516, #26523).

  8. #25166 — Shell command gets stuck with "Waiting input" after completing · 4 comments · 3 👍 · p1 bug After trivial CLI commands finish, the shell tool can hang showing "Awaiting user input." Highly disruptive for automation-heavy usage; an effort/medium fix is in the maintainer backlog.

  9. #21983 — Browser subagent fails on Wayland · 4 comments · p1 bug Browser Agent terminates with "GOAL" despite failing under Wayland, another instance of misleading success reporting. Linux desktop users are affected disproportionately.

  10. #20079 — Symlinked agent files in ~/.gemini/agents are not recognized · 4 comments · p2 bug filename.md symlinks in the agents directory are ignored, breaking common dotfile-management setups (e.g., chezmoi, GNU Stow). A small but quality-of-life issue for power users.

4. Key PR Progress

  1. #29265 — Prevent session context poisoning on interrupted turns · OPEN · p2 · area/agent Fixes a critical issue where SIGINT, timeouts, or aborted tool executions corrupt in-memory session history and break subsequent prompt execution. Directly targets the interruption pain echoed across several top issues.

  2. #29248 — Avoid duplicate history and telemetry after confirmation · OPEN · area/core Stops slash-command history and telemetry from being inserted twice when a confirmation dialog overlaps with an incoming message — e.g., /resume save <tag> with an overwrite prompt.

  3. #29163 — Prevent crash during authentication in git repositories · OPEN · p1 · area/security Fixes startup crashes when useGitBranchName runs inside a macOS Seatbelt-restricted .git directory. Important for users in hardened or sandboxed environments.

  4. #29156 — Stop nullifying user git config in shell executions · OPEN · area/core Reverts an over-aggressive sandboxing change (#28792) that pointed GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM at /dev/null, silently hiding user.name, user.email, and credential helpers from every shell command.

  5. #29155 — Decode BOM-encoded content correctly in isEmpty · OPEN · area/core Fixes UTF-16/UTF-32 whitespace-only plan files being treated as non-empty — NUL-decoded bytes tripped trim() and broke validatePlanContent.

  6. #29151 — Handle skill precedence and active state case-insensitively · OPEN · p1 · area/agent Fixes a case-sensitivity mismatch in SkillManager where workspace skills failed to override built-in/extension skills if names differed only in casing.

  7. #29067 — Remove misleading security schemes and hardcoded credentials from a2a-server · CLOSED · area/security Cleans up coderAgentCard and customUserBuilder, removing fake securitySchemes and hardcoded credentials. Closes #29001.

  8. #29089 — Forward abortSignal to retryWithBackoff in BaseLlmClient · CLOSED · area/core Ensures SessionSummaryService, chat compression, and the classifier actually respect abort signals during retry backoff — previously a cancellation could still burn through retries.

  9. #29088 — Resolve VSCode IDE companion stop() with an MCP stream open · CLOSED · area/core Fixes IdeServer.stop() deadlocking because a long-lived MCP streaming response on GET /mcp prevented the HTTP server from draining. Resolves extension deactivation hangs (#28785).

  10. #29063 — Stop Plan Mode from waiting on user feedback in non-interactive sessions · CLOSED · p1 · area/non-interactive Fixes gemini -p "..." -y Plan Mode runs hanging forever on a user turn that never arrives. Closes the well-known #28913 and its predecessor #26004.

Also notable: #29087 — Prevent concurrent extension install races (CLOSED), which uses proper-lockfile to stop two CLI processes from corrupting the same extension installation.

5. Feature Request Trends

  • AST-aware code intelligence: Multiple issues (#22745, #22746) push for method-bound reads, precise search, and codebase mapping via AST tooling to cut token waste and turn counts.
  • Surgical / token-frugal context loading: The "Tactful Extraction" proposal (#19561) — a grep-first discovery hierarchy — complements the AST work and targets the ~36.6k-token baseline context bloat.
  • OS-level sandboxing for shell execution: #19873 wants zero-dependency sandboxing plus post-execution intent routing, leaning into the model's native bash fluency without the security risk.
  • Subagent observability & governance: Requests include visible subagent trajectories via /chat share (#22598), included subagent context in /bug reports (#21763), and persistent file-based task tracking to replace in-context WriteToDo (#18836).
  • Browser agent resilience: Automatic session takeover and lock recovery for persistent profiles (#22232), plus honoring settings.json overrides (#22267).

6. Developer Pain Points

  • Misleading success reporting: Subagents terminating on MAX_TURNS or Wayland failures report "GOAL success," eroding trust in autonomous workflows (#22323, #21983).
  • Hangs and stuck states: Generalist agent hangs (#21409), shell "Waiting input" deadlocks (#25166), and interactive-prompt traps during scaffolding (#22465) remain the most disruptive day-to-day failures.
  • Auto Memory system trust: The memory subsystem generates a steady stream of bug reports — low-signal retries (#26522), silent invalid patch skips (#26523), and pre-redaction secret exposure (#26525).
  • Agents not using user configuration: Skills and
GitHub Copilot CLI — github/copilot-cli

GitHub Copilot CLI Community Digest — 2026-09-09

1. Today's Highlights

Two patch releases shipped today: v1.0.84-2 makes Vim mode generally available and adds Windows sandbox blocked-access recording, while v1.0.84-3 fixes /copy task-completion output and OAuth-authenticated MCP startup reliability. The issue tracker remains dominated by session-resume failures, MCP configuration friction, and Windows-specific desktop app regressions.

2. Releases

v1.0.84-3

  • Fixed: /copy now includes task completion messages when available.
  • Fixed: OAuth-authenticated MCP servers connect reliably during session startup.

v1.0.84-2

  • New: Vim mode is available to everyone. Enable it with /vim or by setting editorMode to vim; the current mode is shown while typing.
  • Improved: On supported Windows sandbox policies, interactive shell commands now record blocked accesses.

See the release page for details.

3. Hot Issues

  1. #13 — CLI input should have a vi/vim input mode
    Closed after shipping in v1.0.84-2. This was the community’s most-upvoted open feature request with 76 👍 and 11 comments.

  2. #4742 — Desktop app: cannot create a second Local session while one is running
    After desktop app 1.1.15, creating a second Local session fails with “This project already has an active Local workspace.” High-impact regression for parallel working sessions; 10 comments.

  3. #4612 — Runaway FileWatch host-event loop freezes TUI and grows debug log to 13 GB
    Long-running sessions can enter a tight loop that makes the terminal UI unresponsive and writes massive debug logs. Serious stability issue; 9 comments.

  4. **[#4756 — Windows app

Kimi Code CLI — MoonshotAI/kimi-cli

Kimi Code CLI Community Digest — 2026-09-09

Today's Highlights

No new releases landed in the past 24 hours. The main community signal is an open, high-severity auth regression: /login device flow succeeds in the browser but then fails with HTTP 500 on macOS, affecting both the CLI and the VS Code extension. On the engineering side, two PRs target data integrity and fetch reliability — refusing to edit non-UTF-8 files and suppressing duplicated extracted comments.

Releases

No releases in the last 24 hours.

Hot Issues

Only 3 issues were updated in the last 24h; all are listed below.

  • #2638 [OPEN] /login device auth fails with HTTP 500 after successful browser approval (CLI v0.42.0, macOS)
    A fresh blocker for macOS users on the free plan. The browser approval succeeds, but the CLI then receives HTTP 500, and the same failure is reproducible from the VS Code extension. Since login is the entry point, this is likely the most urgent item today. No comments or reactions yet.

  • #1270 [CLOSED] VSCode extension: after typing @, open files should be displayed first
    A UX enhancement request from v0.4.3: when users type @ in the dialog, already-open files should be prioritized because they are the most likely targets for analysis/operations. The issue is now closed, but it reflects a common desire for tighter editor-context integration.

  • #2601 [CLOSED] Quote & Reply: comment on any selected part of an AI response in Kimi Web
    Requests the ability to select any text span in an assistant response — a paragraph, code block, step, or diff line — and attach a follow-up question/comment directly to that selection. Useful for precise conversational continuation. Closed, likely superseded by product changes.

Key PR Progress

Only 2 PRs were updated in the last 24h; both are included.

  • #1863 [CLOSED] fix(fetch): suppress duplicated extracted comment text
    Fixes FetchURL output where Trafilatura extraction can duplicate GitHub issue comments alongside the main body. The change inspects main text and comments separately, suppresses comments that normalize to the same content, and adds a regression test. This improves reliability when the CLI fetches web pages or issue URLs.

  • #2595 [OPEN] fix(StrReplaceFile): refuse to edit files that are not valid UTF-8
    Addresses a silent-corruption bug: StrReplaceFile currently decodes files with errors="replace", applies an edit, then writes everything back — turning any invalid UTF-8 byte into U+FFFD and corrupting bytes unrelated to the edit. The fix refuses to edit non-UTF-8 files instead, protecting file integrity.

Feature Request Trends

From the small issue sample, two directions stand out:

  • Editor-context awareness: Users expect the CLI/extension to prioritize already-open files in @ mentions for faster analysis workflows.
  • Conversational precision: Users want to quote and reply to specific segments of AI-generated responses, especially for following up on code blocks or plan steps.
  • Cross-surface consistency: Issues appearing in both CLI and VS Code extension highlight that users expect the same behavior and reliability across all surfaces.

Developer Pain Points

  • Auth reliability: Device-code login breaking after browser approval is a critical workflow blocker, especially when it spans multiple client surfaces.
  • File-encoding safety: Editing files with non-UTF-8 bytes can silently corrupt them via replacement characters — developers need fail-fast behavior rather than data loss.
  • Noisy fetched content: Duplicate extracted comments from fetched GitHub/web URLs reduce trust in the fetch tool.
  • Context-selection friction: Both open-file prioritization and quote-and-reply requests reflect a common pain point: maintaining precise context while interacting with AI output.

OpenClaw 生态日报 2026-09-09

Issues: 500 | PRs: 500 | 覆盖项目: 13 个 | 生成时间: 2026-09-09 09:31 UTC

  • OpenClaw
  • NanoBot
  • Hermes Agent
  • PicoClaw
  • NanoClaw
  • NullClaw
  • IronClaw
  • LobsterAI
  • TinyClaw
  • Moltis
  • CoPaw
  • ZeptoClaw
  • ZeroClaw

OpenClaw 项目深度报告

⚠️ 摘要生成失败。

横向生态对比

个人 AI 助手 / 自主智能体开源生态横向对比分析报告

报告日期：2026-09-09
数据范围：过去 24 小时 GitHub 公开动态

1. 生态全景

今日个人 AI 助手开源生态呈现“多点迭代、局部拥堵”的态势。在 12 个被监测项目中，9 个有实际动态，其中 3 个项目（NullClaw、TinyClaw、Moltis）完全静默。整体开发热度依然很高，但合并吞吐量明显低于提交量——Hermes Agent 与 ZeroClaw 均出现 50 条 PR 更新但 0 合并的情况，说明社区贡献活跃、维护者审查能力成为瓶颈。迭代重心正从“功能堆叠”转向“体验打磨、稳定性加固与安全边界治理”，多个项目不约而同地处理多租户隔离、凭证泄露、存储膨胀和成本可观测性问题。此外，OpenClaw v2026.8.1 的版本升级在衍生项目中引发连锁兼容性修复，显示核心框架的变动对生态具有强辐射力。

2. 各项目活跃度对比

项目 Issues 更新 PR 更新 Release 健康度评估
OpenClaw 数据缺失（摘要生成失败） 数据缺失 未知 无法评估
NanoBot 2 27（8 合并/关闭，19 待合并） 无 健康，高频迭代，体验打磨
Hermes Agent 50（39 活跃/新开，11 关闭） 50（0 合并，50 待合并） 无 提交活跃但合并瓶颈严重，长期 issue 积压
PicoClaw 3（1 关闭，2 待跟进） 8（1 合并，7 待审） 无 较健康，有 PR 评审积压
NanoClaw 2（均 open） 10（2 合并/关闭，8 待审） 无 健康，功能推进与修复并行
NullClaw

同赛道项目详细报告

NanoBot — HKUDS/nanobot

NanoBot 项目动态日报 — 2026-09-09

1. 今日速览

过去 24 小时 NanoBot 项目保持高活跃度：共 27 条 PR 动态，其中 8 条已合并/关闭，19 条处于待合并状态；Issues 端有 2 条更新。今日集中度非常明显——WebUI/TUI 的体验优化、Bug 修复与性能改进占据了绝大多数合并项，其中 chengyongru 一人贡献了 6 条已合并 PR，覆盖导航保留、流式数学渲染、UI 裁切、性能优化与 TUI 新命令等。无新版本发布，项目正处于高频迭代阶段，健康度良好。

2. 版本发布

过去 24 小时内无新版本 Release。

3. 项目进展

今日共合并/关闭 8 条 PR，整体上前端体验（WebUI/TUI）的稳定性和可用性显著推进，另有 Codex 模型目录修复落地。

WebUI 功能与体验

  • PR #5717（已合并/关闭）：修复从项目菜单创建 topic 时丢失项目选择的问题。改用 history.pushState 避免路由事件清空项目状态，使首条消息即关联正确项目。
  • PR #5716（已合并/关闭）：修复打开技能选择器时建议列表不刷新的问题。Agent 在页面加载后安装的新技能现在无需重载页面即可出现在选择器中。
  • PR #5705（已合并/关闭）：为 TUI 新增 /usage 命令，展示上下文占用率和最近模型轮次用量图表，补齐了 WebUI 已有能力的 TUI 侧缺口。

WebUI 视觉与渲染修复

  • PR #5714（已合并/关闭）：将文件编辑 diff 从 reasoning 折叠块中分离，避免折叠后 diff 内容不可见。
  • PR #5713（已合并/关闭）：修复斜体活动标签在 fit-content + overflow: hidden 下裁切末字符的问题，增加 2px 右内边距。
  • PR #5712（已合并/关闭）：修复流式数学公式中含 < 比较符时响应被截断的问题，例如 \prod_{j<i}(1-\alpha_j)。

性能优化

  • PR #5703（已合并/关闭）：减少长时间对话中的重复 DOM 扫描、活动行搜索和隐藏细节渲染，并限制历史渲染的数据量，显著降低工具密集场景下的渲染开销。

Codex 通道

  • PR #5709（已合并/关闭）：将 Codex 模型目录的客户端版本从 0.144.0 提升至 0.153.4，修复 GPT-6-Astra 模型在选取器中可能不出现的问题。

小结：今日合并内容以 "修复用户可见问题 + 减少长期性能债务" 为主，表明项目正从功能扩展期转向体验打磨与稳定性加固阶段。

4. 社区热点

今日评论最活跃、讨论热度最高的条目集中在 Issues 端：

Issue #5693 — 无人零售/IoT 场景支持建议（3 条评论，已关闭）

  • 内容：用户 linxingming168（标注由"AI 军团·笔芯秘书"自动提交）建议 NanoBot 适配无人零售/智能货柜场景，具体诉求包括：
    1. 增加对无人零售/智能货柜场景的原生支持
    2. 提供更轻量的部署方案以适配边缘设备
    3. 增加中文文档和示例
  • 分析：该 Issue 将 NanoBot 定位为"轻量、开源、可自托管的"智能体，期望复用到 IoT 边缘场景。背后反映了开源 AI Agent 社区对低资源设备落地和本地化文档的明确需求。但 Issue 已被关闭，且由自动化工具提交，实际维护者关注度可能有限。

Issue #5647 — WebUI 会话标题在缺少 webui flag 时不生成（持续更新中）

  • 内容：这是由 PR #5528 引入的一个回归，maybe_generate_webui_title() 仅在 envelope 携带 webui 标志时才生成标题，重启后该标志可能丢失，导致标题不生成。
  • 分析：该 Issue 已持续 6 天并有新的更新，用户 `ZIFe
Hermes Agent — nousresearch/hermes-agent

Hermes Agent 项目动态日报 — 2026-09-09

今日速览

过去 24 小时 Hermes Agent 保持高活跃度：50 条 Issues 更新（新开/活跃 39，关闭 11）与 50 条 PR 更新（全部处于待合并状态，合并/关闭 0），无新版本发布。项目提交节奏密集，仅 teknium1 一人即提交了 8 个跨领域修复/功能 PR，另有多个旧 PR 被 salvage/rebased 重新激活。但需警惕的是 PR 合并量为零，审查与合并瓶颈可能正在累积。Issue 侧最突出的是 **P1 级 MCP profile-scoping 缺陷（#106005）**连续出现，以及 183 评论的 skills index 故障（#66616）持续 50 天未关闭。此外，多条会话状态相关的 P1 bug 集中在过去两天内被报告并被标记为 duplicate/closed，暗示本周可能存在一次回归批。总体判断：开发活跃度高，但合并吞吐与长期 issue 治理急需关注。

项目进展

今日无 PR 被合并或关闭，所有 50 条 PR 均在待合并队列中。但今日新提交的 PR 呈现出清晰的项目演进信号，最值得关注的包括：

PR 内容概要 类型
#106414 Claude Code OAuth identity 版本下限更新，修复 Fable 5.x 模型被拒问题（port prime-agent#1993） 修复
#106418 云实例元数据（IMDS）凭据获取纳入审批范围，增强安全边界（对标 Claude Code 2.1.257） 安全
#106413 Webhook 路由引入 session_key 可选持久会话（salvage #90589，受 Poke 启发） 功能
#106412 CLI 输入组件新增 /vim 可选 vim 编辑模式（关闭 #4254） 功能
#106419 compute-host PID 监管的 Windows 安全 + 僵尸进程修复（salvage #68272） 修复
#106417 V4A Add File 不再覆盖已有文件（salvage #41393） 修复
#106416 视频生成新增 MiniMax H3 Max Turbo 模型族（含 1080P 档位） 功能
#106409 Codex 设备登录 SSL 错误时保留原始错误 + PQ 混合组提示 修复

大量 PR 以 "salvage"（捡起先前被搁置/关闭的 PR）形式重新提交，表明社区贡献管道存在积压，但有维护者在积极催熟。

社区热点

🥇 #66616 Skills index is stale or degraded — 183 评论

  • 状态：OPEN / P3 / 自 2026-07-18 以来持续 50+ 天
  • 自动探针持续报告 /docs/api/skills-index.json 过期（当前 29.8h 超过 26h 限制）
  • 183 条评论高居榜首，反映用户对官方文档/skills 索引可用性的高度在意，且长时间未关闭引发不满

🥈 #10421 Turn-level live time context — 20 评论 / 9 👍

  • 状态：OPEN / P2 / 创建于 2026-04-15，Open 已 147 天
  • 用户痛点集中在 agent 对"当前时间/日期/星期"感知不可靠，必须显式调工具获取
  • 9 个 👍 为今日 Issue 列表最高，是社区呼声最强的功能
PicoClaw — sipeed/picoclaw

PicoClaw 项目动态日报 — 2026-09-09

今日速览

过去 24 小时项目保持较高活跃度：共更新 3 条 Issue（1 条关闭、2 条待跟进）与 8 条 PR（1 条合并、7 条待审），无新版本发布。开发侧以 Telegram 交互修复、IRC 增强和渠道重构为主线，其中一条长期搁置的 skills 模块重构 PR（#714）终于合并，标志着 CLI 技能管理能力完成阶段性整合。社区侧最受关注的是工具反馈动画无限编辑 Telegram 消息的稳定性 Bug（#3343，228,000+ 次误编辑），已有对应修复 PR 待合并，整体项目健康度良好，但 PR 评审积压值得注意。

项目进展

唯一今日合并 PR：skills 模块重构落地

  • #714 [CLOSED] skills: install/reinstall CLI and refactor into skillsCmd（作者: seanly）
    • 重构技能安装逻辑，新增 ParseInstallSpec、InstallFromGitHubEx、fetchTree 等函数，支持 repo@branch 与子路径安装
    • 新增 reinstall 子命令，支持强制覆盖
    • 生产环境安装改用 GitHub Trees API 获取完整目录，并优化已存在时的错误提示

这标志着技能管理从"可用"走向"可维护"，为后续技能生态扩展打下基础。

社区热点

条目 热度指标 核心诉求
#3343 [BUG] 工具反馈动画无限编辑 Telegram 消息 3 评论，228,000+ 次误编辑 资源控制与限流规避：动画未随 agent turn 结束而停止，连续数天每 3 秒调用一次 editMessageText，触发 Telegram 服务端限流。用户关注失控行为的主动终止机制
#3265 [CLOSED] Gateway 启动时 deltachat 频道类型报错 4 评论，1 👍 配置容错：未配置 deltachat 却启动失败，暴露频道初始化逻辑对默认配置的兼容性问题，已关闭（可能是修复或标记 stale）
#3355 [BUG] 连接飞书报错：未知字段 channel_list.feishu.app_id 1 评论 配置结构变更/文档不同步：nightly 版本不识别文档示例中的字段名，需要官方明确配置 schema 变更

分析：社区焦点集中在「运行时边界控制」与「配置一致性」两大方向。Telegram 动画 Bug 因涉及限流和长时间资源消耗而关注度最高，用户期待快速合入修复。

Bug 与稳定性

按严重程度排序：

高严重度

  • #3343 工具反馈动画无限编辑 Telegram 消息
    • 现象：动画持续数天、每 3 秒一次编辑，累计 228,000+ 次，触发 Telegram retry_after 限流
    • 修复：已有 PR #3353 fix(channels): bound tool feedback animations，设置 5 分钟上限、首次编辑错误即停止，待合并评审

中严重度

  • #3355 飞书配置未知字段 app_id
    • 现象：nightly-50-gbbf6893c 无法识别配置中的 channel_list.feishu.app_id
    • 当前无对应 fix PR，需确认是配置迁移还是文档过时

已解决/关闭

  • #3265 Gateway 启动报未知 deltachat 类型 —— 已关闭，不再影响用户

功能请求与路线图信号

以下 PR 均处于待合并状态，指向下一版本的可能特性：

新渠道能力

  • #3354 feat(irc): assemble IRCv3 multiline messages（作者: linhongyu510）—— 支持 IRCv3 draft/multiline，让长消息/多行消息作为整体进入 agent，依赖 batch 和 message-tags 能力协商
  • #3344 Add Build Remote Agent phone pairing (gbr/1)（作者: LinespottingPrivate）—— 新增 gbr/1 协议配对适配器，允许手机端作为 Remote Agent 远程围观/控制桌面 agent，附二维码与 8 位码配对

模型提供商扩展

  • #3371 feat(providers): add opencode-go provider with session header support（作者: EMTumariscal）—— 新增 opencode-go 提供商，按模型 ID 自动路由 endpoint 族，并附带 x-opencode-session 会话头支持

Telegram 体验优化

  • #3357 fix(telegram): treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions（作者: hugodeco）—— mention_only: true 群组中直接回复 bot 消息视为提及，保持对话连续性
  • #3356 fix(telegram): re-attach quoted documents when replying to a file message（作者: hugodeco）—— 回复引用的文档消息时重新附加文档本体，而非只传 [file] 占位符

渠道重构

  • #3222 refactor(deltachat): cleanup implementation, documentation -200LOC（作者: trufae）—— 删除遗留特性，移除硬编码 relay 列表，密码配置迁移至 jsonrpc，接口按语义更名（invite_link → join_invite_link + show_invite_link）

路线图判断：IRC 多行、Telegram 回复语义增强、opencode-go 提供商实现均已完成且逻辑独立，大概率随下个 nightly 或 minor release 合入；#3344 因引入新外部依赖（MIT gbr-agent）可能需更长期评审。

用户反馈摘要

来源 用户声音 核心诉求
#3343 raine "动画在 agent turn 停止后仍继续调用 editMessageText，持续数天……产生 228,000 次编辑尝试" 对失控后台行为零容忍，希望所有异步反馈都有终态保障
#3355 ttghub "nightly-50-gbbf6893c 报 unknown field(s): channel_list.feishu.app_id" 期望配置文档与实际实现保持同步，nightly 变更需在 Release Notes 标注 breaking changes
#3265 Cipher208 "没有配置 deltachat，Gateway 依然启动失败" 服务启动应具备配置缺失容错，不应因默认未启用的频道崩溃

共性反馈：用户对 PicoClaw 的稳定性和配置可预测性有较高期待，nightly 构建的配置兼容性问题已被多次触及。

待处理积压

条目 搁置时长 说明与优先级
#3222 refactor(deltachat): cleanup implementation 自 2026-07-03 起，68 天 大型重构 PR，已攒大量 review 负担，且与 #3265 关闭直接相关，建议优先安排 reviewer；涉及 breaking changes（密码配置移除），合入前需同步更新文档

IronClaw — nearai/ironclaw

IronClaw 项目动态日报 — 2026-09-09

1. 今日速览

IronClaw 在过去 24 小时迎来一轮高度集中的开发冲刺：共 11 条 PR 被提交或关闭，其中 5 条关闭、6 条待合并，另有 2 条 Issue 处于活跃状态。所有活跃 PR 均由同一核心贡献者（kirikov）于 9 月 8 日密集提交，指向一个清晰的主线——修复 Hosted-MCP 多租户环境下的工具目录隔离问题。值得关注的是，围绕 7 月底报告的跨用户元数据暴露 Issue（#6778），已形成一套包含合并目录、按调用者隔离、SEP-414 溯源在内的组合修复方案。项目整体活跃度高，开发方向聚焦，但需留意多组功能存在重叠/承继关系，评估时需避免重复合入。

2. 版本发布

过去 24 小时无新版本发布。

3. 项目进展

今日关闭/合并的 5 条 PR 中，3 条为实质性变更，2 条为旧 PR 收尾：

  • 修复 Hosted-MCP 工具目录互相覆盖（#8083，merged）：将"发现的 hosted-MCP 目录"从「整体替换」改为「合并」，避免不同用户的工具在共享注册槽位中互相删除。这是对 #6778 跨用户暴露问题的第一层修复。
  • 区分空环境变量与未设置变量（#8088，closed）：env_or_override 不再将 FOO= 与缺失的 FOO 等同对待，避免运维将配置项误设为空字符串时静默回退到默认值。
  • 捆绑 agent-market hosted-MCP 提供方包（#8089，closed）：为 agent.market 提供方补齐了第一方捆绑包（manifest、tool schemas、静态声明），作为 live tools/list discovery 之前的 fallback。

另两条旧 PR（#6760、#6759）分别被标记为"superseded"和"needs rebase"，建议维护者明确关闭或回收。

项目进展小结：Hosted-MCP 多用户隔离问题的修复已经从"讨论"走向"落地"；同时基础配置语义（空 env var）得到加固；agent.market 扩展的完整接入进入最终阶段。整体来看，项目在扩展系统稳定性和托管 MCP 安全性两个方向都有实质推进。

4. 社区热点

  • #6778 Hosted-MCP 工具目录跨用户暴露（评论 2，更新于 09-08）：这是今日最受关注的 Issue。它揭示了一个深层设计缺陷——工具目录按 extension id 单槽发布，而非按安装/用户维度，在 multi-principal 服务器上会造成 A 用户的工具列表被 B 用户的 discovery 覆盖，且元数据跨用户可见。该 Issue 虽创建于 7 月底，但今日迎来集中响应：直接催生了 3 条相关 PR（#8083、#8090、#8084）。

  • #8086 ironclaw skills list 看不到运行时写入的 skills（新开，0 评论）：虽然是新 Issue，但其描述的"用 CLI 调试 agent 却拿到空列表"的场景非常典型，直击开发者工具链的可观测性短板。该 Issue 指向的可能是 CLI 与运行时之间不同的用户/凭据上下文，而非单一 bug。

5. Bug 与稳定性

按严重程度排列：

严重度 问题 状态
高 Hosted-MCP 工具目录跨用户覆盖及元数据暴露（#6778）：多用户共享服务器上，后一次 discovery 覆盖前一次，且工具目录按 extension id 全局可见，构成数据泄露风险 已有修复 PR：#8083（合并目录，已关闭）、#8090（按 caller 键控，待合并）
中 Operator 安装的包无法被使用（#8085）：from_host_bundled_manifest_with_inline_dynamic_schemas 构造函数与 validate_consistency 校验器对"哪些 manifest 来源允许内联动态 schema"存在不一致判断，导致 operator 安装的包能构建但不能用 修复 PR 待合并
中 空环境变量静默选默认值（#8088）：FOO= 与未设置等同，运维误配置会静默失败 已修复（PR 已关闭）
低 CLI 无法列出 runtime 写入的 skills（#8086）：排查 agent 技能问题时，CLI 给出空列表，将用户引向错误方向 待处理

6. 功能请求与路线图信号

  • SEP-414 溯源机制落地（#8084，待合并）：在出站 hosted-MCP 调用上打 _meta 溯源标记，让多租户 MCP 服务器能够识别调用来自哪个 conversation 以及是否为重试。对按调用计费、需要防止 side-effecting 调用重复扣费的 provider 有直接价值。替代并继承早前搁置的 #6759。
  • Prompt 上下文阈值可配置化（#8087，待合并）：PromptContextTokenBudget::DEFAULT_CONTEXT_LIMIT_TOKENS 从常量改为可覆盖配置，适配更大上下文窗口的模型部署。
  • 文档附件指针模式（#8082，待合并）：将文档文本从"内联到模型请求"改为"按需 pointer 引用"，避免多附件场景下 context 预算被快速耗尽。
  • Telegram 命令菜单自动注册（#8072，待合并）：在扩展激活时调用 setMyCommands，并尽力清理；改善终端用户体验。
  • agent-market 市场化扩展正式化（#8089，已关闭）：作为 hosted-MCP 第一方包捆绑，与既有 bundled 扩展形态对齐。

综合来看，下一版本很可能包含：#8084（SEP-414）、#8085（operator 包修复）、#8087（context 限制可配）、#8082（附件指针模式）以及 #8090（按 caller 隔离）。

7. 用户反馈摘要

  • 多租户部署者的核心顾虑（来自 #6778 评论）：在共享的 hosted-MCP 服务器上，不同用户的工具目录互相污染是"必然复现"的——只要两个用户的 discovery 先后触发就会互相覆盖。评论者关注的核心不是「工具可见性」，而是跨用户元数据暴露带来的安全风险。
  • 调试者的挫败感（来自 #8086）：当 agent 安装的技能对 CLI 不可见时，用户第一反应是"我的 agent 坏了"，而实际上问题可能只是 CLI 与 runtime 的用户上下文不一致。用户期待 CLI 能看到并区分所有用户的 skills，而不是只看到自己配置的那个。
  • 运维人员的隐形坑（来自 #8088）：空字符串覆盖默认值的行为很难被发现——配置看起来"设置了"，实际却静默走了默认路径。这类问题在事故排查中会极大浪费定位时间。

8. 待处理积压

  • #6778 Hosted-MCP 跨用户暴露：创建于 07-28，拖延超一个月。今日虽有 #8083 合入（合并目录）和 #8090（按调用者键控）兜底，但建议维护者在 #8090 合入后明确关闭 #6778 并附上修复说明，避免历史 Issue 长期悬挂。
  • #6759 SEP-414 溯源（旧版）：07-28 开启，标记 "Needs a rebase"，已被 #8084 取代。建议弃用并引导至新 PR。
  • #6760 agent-market 扩展（旧版）：07-28 开启，标记 "Superseded in shape, not in intent"，已被 #8089 取代。建议关闭以避免产生新旧两条实现路径的困惑。

    • 关键进展: 该 PR 由维护者 qhkm 提交，旨在解决一个安全问题。此前 Panel 的 WebSocket 连接会将长期有效的 API Token 或 JWT 放在 URL 的 ?auth= 参数中，这可能导致凭证被访问日志或浏览器历史记录泄露。
    • 影响评估: 该修复引入了一个基于认证和 CSRF 保护的端点，来获取 30 秒有效的单次使用票据 (ticket)，并在 WebSocket 升级时使用。这显著提升了 Panel 连接的安全性。虽然该 PR 尚未合并，但它明确了项目正在积极修复潜在的安全风险，向更安全、更健壮的方向演进。

    • 这是今日唯一的新 Issue。作者 putraperdana1207-pixel 在摘要中高度认可了 ZeptoClaw 的设计理念，即在体积（~6MB）和启动速度（~50ms）上的极致追求。
    • 背后诉求: 该请求表明，部分用户已经将 ZeptoClaw 视为在边缘或容器不友好的环境中部署 AI 助手的理想选择。支持 OrcaRouter 这类 provider 是希望进一步扩展项目的接入生态，让用户在模型提供商上有更多选择。这体现了用户对项目轻量级定位的肯定，并提出具体的集成期望。

    • 这条 PR 虽然由维护者提出，但因其解决的是潜在的数据安全问题，同样引发了关注（尽管评论为0）。它反映了在安全审计或内部代码审查中发现的隐患，是项目走向成熟化过程中的重要一步。

OpenClaw Ecosystem Digest 2026-09-09

Issues: 500 | PRs: 500 | Projects covered: 13 | Generated: 2026-09-09 09:31 UTC

  • OpenClaw
  • NanoBot
  • Hermes Agent
  • PicoClaw
  • NanoClaw
  • NullClaw
  • IronClaw
  • LobsterAI
  • TinyClaw
  • Moltis
  • CoPaw
  • ZeptoClaw
  • ZeroClaw

OpenClaw Deep Dive

OpenClaw Project Digest — 2026-09-09

1. Today's Overview

OpenClaw shows very high activity: 500 issues and 500 PRs were updated in the last 24 hours, with 217 issues closed and 206 PRs merged/closed — indicating strong triage throughput. A new patch release, v2026.9.3, shipped with a focus on safer self-update mechanics (candidate-state rehearsal and abandoned-update recovery), directly targeting a cluster of update-path regressions reported in 2026.8.x/9.x. Despite the volume of closed work, several P0 release-blockers remain open, notably Codex OAuth refresh timeouts (#89278), a Windows de-DE upgrade maintenance block (#136203), and Feishu plugin tools being silently dropped (#140971, fix PR open). Community reporting continues to concentrate on regressions introduced in the 2026.8.1–2026.9.2 range, with auth-provider and message-loss impact areas dominating.

2. Releases

v2026.9.3 (release) — openclaw 2026.9.3

Highlights:

  • Safer updates: core and plugin changes are now rehearsed in an isolated candidate state before activation.
  • Migration support: eligible 2026.9.2 migrations are supported.
  • Recovery: abandoned update records can be recovered without stopping a healthy matching Gateway (related #136997).

No breaking changes or explicit migration steps were announced. The release appears designed to address the update-path pain visible in the tracker: stuck npm updates (#141617), core/plugin version skew after openclaw update (#135776), and Windows upgrade maintenance locks (#136203).

3. Project Progress

Merged/closed today: 206 PRs; 217 issues closed.

Notable PRs currently in the pipeline (updated in last 24h):

  • Discord presence fix — merged/closed: #141218 — show member presence immediately after reconnect (fixes #141054).
  • Feishu tool siloing fix (P0 regression): #141984 — avoids collateral drop of non-restricted Feishu tools; closes #140971.
  • iMessage bridge recovery: #142626 — restores typing indicators/read receipts after bridge recovery; automerge armed.
  • Memory recall reliability: #142693 — continues memory recall when optional trigger lookup times out; closes #142479.
  • OpenAI-compatible provider text doubling: #142888 — fixes live assistant text duplicating when providers resend full content in one delta; closes #136262.
  • Image job lifecycle: #142991 — keeps accepted image_generate jobs alive through provider cleanup (related #140674).
  • Documentation restructure: a sustained effort by vincentkoc to split oversized docs pages (ledger findings) — gateway CLI (#143005), browser tools (#142984), subagents (#142999), Ollama provider (#143004), Matrix channel (#142996), TTS (#142992), and the Updating guide (#142993).
  • **Mobile/edge surfaces

Cross-Ecosystem Comparison

Cross-Project Comparison Report — Personal AI Assistant / Agent Open-Source Ecosystem

Date: 2026-09-09 | Source: Community digest summaries for 10 projects (2 unavailable)

1. Ecosystem Overview

The open-source personal AI assistant ecosystem remains dominated by OpenClaw-derived or OpenClaw-compatible architectures, with the core reference project processing an extraordinary ~1,000 items/day of issue+PR activity and shipping regular patch releases. The broader landscape shows a two-speed dynamic: a few high-throughput projects (OpenClaw, LobsterAI, NanoBot, Hermes Agent) are absorbing large volumes of triage and compatibility work, while a long tail of smaller forks (PicoClaw, NanoClaw, IronClaw, ZeptoClaw) iterate on niche channel integrations and edge deployments. Across all active projects, the dominant themes are update-path reliability, IM channel compatibility after upstream upgrades, provider/routing flexibility, and security hardening — indicating an ecosystem maturing from "demo-ware" into production operations. Notably, CoPaw and ZeroClaw failed digest generation this cycle, and three projects (NullClaw, TinyClaw, Moltis) recorded zero activity, suggesting consolidation or stalled maintenance in parts of the ecosystem.

2. Activity Comparison

Project Issues (24h) PRs (24h) Release (24h) Health Score¹ Notes
OpenClaw 500 updated / 217 closed 500 updated / 206 merged-closed ✅ v2026.9.3 9/10 Extreme throughput; P0 blockers remain (OAuth, Windows upgrade, Feishu tools)
LobsterAI 20 updated / 4 closed 14 touched / 12 merged-closed ❌ 7/10 High merge velocity; 5 open security advisories; compatibility-fix driven
NanoBot 2 updated 27 touched / 8 closed ❌ 8/10 Fast, focused WebUI/TUI fixes; healthy maintainer cadence
Hermes Agent 50 updated / 11 closed 50 updated / 0 merged ❌ 6/10 Heavy triage but review/landing backlog; no code landed
IronClaw 2 open 11 touched / 5 merged-closed ❌ 7/10 Focused MCP catalog work; security issue open since July
PicoClaw 3 updated / 1 closed 8 touched / 1 closed ❌ 6/10 Good contributor output; maintainer review lagging
NanoClaw 2 open 10 touched / 2 merged ❌ 7/10 Active, targeted fixes; 2 operational bugs without fix PRs
ZeptoClaw 1 open 1 open ❌ 5/10 Light activity; security fix pending review
NullClaw — — ❌ 1/10 No activity
TinyClaw — — ❌ 1/10 No activity
Moltis — — ❌ 1/10 No activity
CoPaw — — — N/A Digest generation failed
ZeroClaw — — — N/A Digest generation failed

¹ Composite of activity volume, merge velocity, issue closure rate, and blocker severity. Qualitative estimate for decision-making, not a formal metric.

3. OpenClaw's Position

OpenClaw is the undisputed ecosystem hub: its 24-hour throughput (500 issues, 500 PRs, 217 issue closures, 206 PRs merged/closed) exceeds the combined activity of all other tracked projects by an order of magnitude. Its technical leadership rests on three pillars: (1) a safer self-update mechanism (candidate-state rehearsal, abandoned-update recovery in v2026.9.3) that directly addresses the ecosystem's most painful failure mode; (2) breadth of channel/provider support — Discord, Feishu, iMessage, Matrix, OpenAI-compatible providers — while smaller projects handle one or two channels; and (3) release discipline, shipping versioned patches while most peers remain unreleased on main. Its main vulnerabilities are the cluster of open P0 regressions (Codex OAuth refresh timeouts, Windows de-DE upgrade maintenance lock, Feishu tool siloing) — all concentrated in the 2026.8.1–2026.9.2 range, which is precisely the upgrade wave now breaking across downstream projects like LobsterAI. Community-size comparison is stark: OpenClaw's 217 closed issues in one day exceeds the total open+closed item count of all smaller projects combined.

4. Shared Technical Focus Areas

Cross-project requirements emerging independently across multiple codebases:

Focus Area Projects Affected Specific Needs
Update/upgrade path reliability OpenClaw, LobsterAI, NanoClaw, PicoClaw Stuck npm updates, core/plugin version skew, Windows upgrade locks, upgrade-triggered channel breakage, broken /update-nanoclaw, config schema mismatch after nightly builds
IM channel integration robustness OpenClaw, LobsterAI, PicoClaw, NanoClaw, IronClaw Feishu tools silently dropped; Telegram reply/mention handling, runaway edit loops, document context loss; WhatsApp JID filtering; DingTalk/Lark/NIM/QQ compatibility after upstream bump; IRCv3 multiline
Provider/routing flexibility ZeptoClaw, NanoClaw, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw OrcaRouter support; OpenCode provider contracts; OpenAI-compatible text doubling; streaming SSE fixes; provider-agnostic session headers
Context & memory management OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, NanoClaw, IronClaw, LobsterAI Memory recall timeouts, unbounded conversation archive growth, prompt-context token budget overrides, pointer mode for document inlining, persistent cross-session memory
Security & authentication ZeptoClaw, LobsterAI, IronClaw, OpenClaw WebSocket bearer-token exposure, unauthenticated local token proxy, symlink file disclosure, cross-user MCP metadata leakage, OAuth refresh timeouts
MCP / tool catalog lifecycle IronClaw, Hermes Agent Per-principal catalog isolation (not per-extension), profile-scoped MCP reliability, catalog merge vs. replace semantics
Task scheduling correctness NanoClaw, LobsterAI Recurrence changes not rescheduling next fire time; cron run-history duplication after upgrades
WebUI/desktop stability NanoBot, LobsterAI UI freezes, skill picker refresh, project-selection races, backup deadlocks

5. Differentiation Analysis

Project Core Focus Target Users Architecture / Notable Traits
OpenClaw Full-featured reference assistant; update safety; broad channel support General developers, self-hosters Gateway + plugins + candidate-state rehearsal; largest contributor base
Hermes Agent Research-grade agent runtime (NousResearch) AI researchers, multi-profile deployments Multiplexed gateway, compute-host PID supervision, vision format breadth (HEIC/AVIF), profile-scoped MCP
LobsterAI Desktop app for Chinese ecosystem NetEase Youdao users; China market Bundles OpenClaw core; QQ/DingTalk/Lark/NIM/Bee channels; i18n; Windows desktop UX
NanoBot Lightweight agent with strong WebUI/TUI Hobbyists, local-first users Focus on UI polish; streaming math rendering; TUI /usage; skill picker
IronClaw Hosted-MCP & extension system Multi-tenant server operators Rust/crate-based extension packaging; per-principal tool catalog keying; SEP-414 attribution
PicoClaw Channel-reliability specialist (Sipeed) Hardware/edge users, IRC/Telegram communities Small-footprint; phone-pairing adapter; IRCv3 multiline; Telegram mention-only workflows
NanoClaw Community/ops-focused agent (Echo/Slack portal) Self-hosters, WhatsApp users Community-cell setup in browser; thread-per-invocation routing; WhatsApp edge cases
ZeptoClaw Ultra-lightweight Rust binary (~6MB, ~50ms startup) Edge/IoT, constrained environments Minimal footprint as value proposition; needs broader provider support

6. Community Momentum & Maturity

Tier 1 — Rapid iteration / shipping: OpenClaw is the only project shipping releases this cycle and sustaining four-digit monthly throughput; its v2026.9.3 release marks a stabilizing phase after the 2026.8.x regression wave. LobsterAI is iterating fastest per-capita — 12 PRs merged in one day — but is in a reactive compatibility-fix mode with an accumulating security-debt backlog.

Tier 2 — Active but backlog-bound: NanoBot shows the healthiest maintainer cadence (small fixes closed quickly, no release needed). Hermes Agent is in a "review bottleneck": 50 PRs touched, zero merged — strong contributor interest but poor landing velocity. NanoClaw and IronClaw are steadily landing targeted fixes; IronClaw shows healthy refinement loops, though repeated rework on the same MCP catalog bug signals weak upfront design specification.

Tier 3 — Contributor-led, maintainer-starved: PicoClaw has engaged contributors submitting real bug fixes (Telegram runaway animation, IRC multiline) but no merges this cycle; several PRs risk staleness. ZeptoClaw has a high-value security fix waiting for review.

Tier 4 — Dormant/failed: NullClaw, TinyClaw, Moltis had zero activity; CoPaw and ZeroClaw digest generation failed — ecosystem consolidation appears underway.

7. Trend Signals

  1. Update mechanics are the new moat. Three separate projects (OpenClaw, LobsterAI, NanoClaw) are actively fixing upgrade-induced breakage. OpenClaw's candidate-state rehearsal will likely become the reference pattern; downstream projects must design for upstream-version skew as a first-class concern.

  2. Multi-tenant isolation is the next security frontier. IronClaw's cross-user MCP metadata exposure (#6778) and LobsterAI's five open security advisories signal that single-user assumptions are breaking as agents move to shared servers. Per-principal keying, ticket-based WebSocket auth, and SSRF guard defaults will be differentiators.

  3. Context-window economics are driving architecture. Independent signals: IronClaw's pointer/reference mode for document inlining, prompt-context limit overrides, NanoClaw's unbounded archive complaint, and LobsterAI's token-waste reports all point to the same conclusion — token/context management is becoming a user-visible product feature, not just an internal detail.

  4. Provider agnosticism is table stakes. OpenClaw fixes OpenAI-compatible duplication, ZeptoClaw users request OrcaRouter, NanoClaw integrates OpenCode, Hermes Agent fixes Gemini SSE. Agents that lock to a single provider will lose mindshare

Peer Project Reports

NanoBot — HKUDS/nanobot

1. Today’s Overview

NanoBot showed a high level of activity on 2026-09-09: 27 pull requests were updated in the last 24 hours, with 8 moving to closed status and 19 remaining open. The bulk of closed work centered on WebUI stability and UX fixes — project selection, skill picker refresh, streaming math rendering, activity layout, and performance — plus a new TUI /usage feature. Only 2 issues were updated, one closed feature request and one open WebUI bug. No new releases were published. Overall project health looks strong: maintainers are closing small, focused fixes quickly while continuing to iterate on larger WebUI settings/sidebar and TUI onboarding efforts.

2. Releases

No new NanoBot releases were published in this window. There are no changelog entries, breaking changes, or migration notes to report.

3. Project Progress

Eight PRs moved to closed status in the last 24 hours. These represent the main landed/closed work:

  • PR #5717 — fix(webui): preserve project when creating a topic from its menu
    Fixes a race where changing the URL hash cleared the selected project after creating a topic from a project context menu.

  • PR #5703 — perf(webui): reduce repeated work and bound history rendering
    Reduces repeated DOM scans, bounds expensive rendering/caching paths for long conversations and tool-heavy responses.

  • PR #5716 — fix(webui): refresh skill suggestions when opening the picker
    Ensures newly installed agent skills appear in the WebUI picker without requiring a page reload.

  • PR #5714 — fix(webui): keep edit diffs outside reasoning folds

Hermes Agent is in a high-activity triage window: 50 issues and 50 PRs were updated in the last 24 hours, with 11 issues closed and 39 still open/active. No PRs were merged or closed during the window, and no new releases were published. Contributor activity is strong, with several new PRs salvaging older community fixes, but zero merged PRs means the project is still in a review/landing backlog rather than a fast-shipping phase.

However, 11 issues were closed, mostly triage/duplicate cleanup. Notable closed bugs include:

PicoClaw Project Digest — 2026-09-09

Today's Overview

PicoClaw showed moderate-to-high community activity on 2026-09-09: 3 issues were updated (2 still open, 1 closed as stale) and 8 pull requests were touched (7 open, 1 closed). No new releases were published. Contributor focus is heavily on channel reliability: Telegram reply handling, runaway feedback animations, IRCv3 multiline support, and a new provider integration. Maintainers closed an older skills CLI PR and a stale DeltaChat startup bug report. The project is healthy overall, but the growing stack of open PRs needs maintainer review, especially PRs that directly fix active bugs.

Releases

No new releases were published during the report window.

Project Progress

  • #714 [closed] skills: install/reinstall CLI and refactor into skillsCmd — Closed after a long lifecycle; it proposed ParseInstallSpec, InstallFromGitHubEx, reinstall subcommand support, and a GitHub Trees API-based install flow.
  • #3265 [closed] Gateway startup fails with 'channel deltachat has unknown type deltachat' — Closed as stale; no active code change tied to it in this window.

No PRs were merged in the last 24 hours, so no confirmed feature/landed code progress to report beyond the closed PR above.

Community Hot Topics

  • #3265 — Gateway startup fails with 'channel deltachat has unknown type deltachat' — Most-commented item with 4 comments and 1 👍. Although closed as stale, it highlights user confusion when an unconfigured channel still causes startup failures.
  • #3343 — Tool feedback animation can edit a Telegram message indefinitely after a failed turn — Active bug report with 3 comments; documents 228,000 edit attempts and Telegram rate limiting.
  • #3355 — config.json contains unknown field(s): channel_list.feishu.app_id — Feishu configuration error; likely a schema/versioning mismatch, with no maintainer response yet.

Underlying need: users want predictable gateway startup, clear configuration errors, and no runaway background behavior on messaging channels.

Bugs & Stability

Ranked by severity:

  1. High — Telegram tool feedback animation runaway loop
    #3343 — A tool feedback animation kept calling editMessageText every 3 seconds for days, causing over 228,000 attempts and Telegram server-side rate limiting.
    Fix PR exists: #3353 bounds animation lifetime and stops on first edit error.

  2. Medium — Feishu config validation rejects valid-looking config
    #3355 — Nightly build with channel_list.feishu.app_id reports "unknown field(s)." Needs maintainer clarification on expected schema.

  3. Low / Closed — DeltaChat startup error when not configured
    #3265 — Gateway failed with "unknown type deltachat" even without DeltaChat configuration. Closed as stale, but the report was never explicitly resolved.

Feature Requests & Roadmap Signals

No new feature-request issues were filed in the window, but several open PRs signal roadmap direction:

  • #3354 — feat(irc): assemble IRCv3 multiline messages — Adds draft/multiline receive support so long IRC messages arrive as one message.
  • #3357 — fix(telegram): treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions — Important for mention_only: true group workflows.
  • #3356 — fix(telegram): re-attach quoted documents when replying to a file message — Restores document context in quoted replies.
  • #3371 — feat(providers): add opencode-go provider with session header support — Adds a dedicated provider for OpenCode Go with model-based routing and session headers.
  • #3344 — Add Build Remote Agent phone pairing (gbr/1) — New phone pairing adapter for remote spectation.

Likely next-version candidates: the Telegram fix set (#3353, #3356, #3357), IRC multiline support, and possibly the OpenCode Go provider, assuming maintainer review proceeds.

User Feedback Summary

  • Telegram users are frustrated by ignored replies in mention_only groups when replying directly to a bot message; the workaround requiring an explicit @mention breaks natural conversation flow.
  • Telegram document context loss is another concrete pain point: quoted replies to files only send [file] to the agent, losing the actual document.
  • Runaway tool feedback animation caused external API abuse/rate limiting and made the system appear unhealthy to users.
  • Feishu users hit config validation errors that should ideally be caught by clear schema/docs.
  • IRC users need multiline messages preserved; contributor activity suggests this is a desired capability.
  • Overall, contributors are actively submitting targeted fixes for existing bugs, indicating an engaged but somewhat frustrated user base dealing with channel-integration edge cases.

Backlog Watch

  • #3222 — refactor(deltachat): cleanup implementation, documentation -200LOC — Open since July 3; large refactor waiting for maintainer review. May risk becoming stale.
  • #3344 — Add Build Remote Agent phone pairing (gbr/1) — Open since August 23; no visible maintainer response. Needs triage.

  • #3353 / #3356 / #3357 — Telegram fix PRs opened Aug 31–Sep 1; each targets a real reported bug and should be prioritized for review/merge.

The underlying needs are clear: production users want bounded storage/hygiene for agent transcripts, and task scheduling must react immediately to recurrence changes.

Ranked by estimated severity:

    Archive files accumulate forever for every agent group. This can cause disk exhaustion on long-running fleets. No fix PR is linked yet.

    nanocoai/nanoclaw PR #3752

    Adds OpenCode to the interactive setup flow and routes authentication/host assistance through provider-owned adapters.
